questions.question: What did the people resolve to do in response to Ezra's grief?
options: Rebuild the broken walls of the holy city
Set out at once to leave the whole city of Jerusalem
Make a covenant to put away their foreign wives
Offer a great sacrifice and hold a feast
questions.answer: Make a covenant to put away their foreign wives

questions.question: How did the assembly respond when gathered in the rain?
options: They mocked Ezra openly for his harsh and strict demands
They left the great assembly and all went back home
They agreed but asked for time to handle it properly
They flatly refused to change any of their old ways
questions.answer: They agreed but asked for time to handle it properly
